paragraphs: Ravna Ukva and Ravna Neḥemyah, sons of Rav's daughter, Bava Batra 51b. They were called 'princes of pride,' meaning wealthy and close to royalty, Ḥullin 92a. Rav Ḥisda had Ravna Ukva expound, Pesaḥim 115b: he authorized him to expound. Rashi, Beitzah 29a, explains adberei as leading him and walking with him in the city's lanes. Sotah 39a: Rav Ukva.
